title: Only work for a single day
text:
Only work for a single day. Worked great for the first day, but then on the second day the intake and exhaust were completely non-operational. No matter which settings I chose, it was not moving any air other than locally.

I removed and then reattached the intake and exhaust hoses, removed and reattached the filter, checked the drain plug, and scrolled through each option available. Nothing seemed to work.

I'm incredibly disappointed.
